collection.title: Suzuki Carry 1999 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Suzuki Carry 1999 - 2006 model requires a 16" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. There is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
